capabilities: Edit footnote definitions directly in a right sidebar
Jump between in-text markers, sidebar cards, and definitions
Search and filter footnotes by number, id, or content
Delete a footnote's marker and definition in one change
Add footnotes before deciding where their markers go
extras: Free with an optional Ko-fi donation link; UI is localized in English, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Known limits documented: inline footnotes are not editable from the sidebar, and editor hotkeys like Ctrl/Cmd+B do not work inside rendered cards.
motivation: The author found that Obsidian footnotes become hard to work with in long notes, papers, and research drafts, and wanted footnotes to be a stable right-side editing workspace rather than text hidden at the end of the note.
problem: In long notes and papers, footnote markers and definitions sit far apart, so editing, searching, and deleting footnotes means constant scrolling and often leaves stray syntax behind.

relations.evidence: With Tidy Footnotes installed, you can turn on "Auto tidy after a new footnote" in the settings

summary: Footnote sidebar workspace that lets you add, edit, search, expand, and delete footnotes without scrolling between markers and definitions.
